quote: To awaken quite alone in a strange town is one of the pleasantest sensations in the world. You are surrounded by adventure. You have no idea of what is in store for you, but you will, if you are wise and know the art of travel, let yourself go on the stream of the unknown and accept whatever comes in the spirit in which the gods may offer it.
source: Freya Stark, Baghdad Sketches, In the Moslem Quarter, opening sentences, p. 17 (John Murray, 1937)
